page_title: MAR 4-0 LOR | Marseille v Lorient 12/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Thomas Leonard has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' 4 - 0 Goal! Arthur Vermeeren sets up Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom right corner. 4:0.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
86' That's a clear yellow card. Igor Paixao (Marseille) goes into the book.
86' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
84' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) picks up an injury.
80' The current number of shots on goal is 7:1.
78' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Benjamin Pavard is replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille).
74' The substitution has been made. Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) has replaced Joel Mvuka Mugisha.
73' What a big chance! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.

72' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Yvon Mvogo pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
71' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
68' Marseille keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
67' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner with a short pass.

64' Igor Paixao (Marseille) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
62' Substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arthur Avom (Lorient).
62' Here is a change. Sambou Soumano is going off and Olivier Pantaloni gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Theo Le Bris (Lorient) comes onto the pitch for Dermane Karim.
61' None of the Marseille players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
61' Timothy Weah comes off the pitch to be replaced by Igor Paixao (Marseille).
61' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia will be replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Emerson (Marseille) is replacing Facundo Medina.

60' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
57' The resulting corner from Bilal Nadir (Marseille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
55' What was Dermane Karim (Lorient) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
55' Angel Gomes (Marseille) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
55' Dermane Karim (Lorient) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Marseille have been awarded a free kick.
53' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Angel Gomes (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
53' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mason Greenwood (Marseille), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
53' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Marseille win a corner.
50' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A cross into the box from Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) is cleared.
47' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) works the corner short.
46' Referee Thomas Leonard blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+5' Timothy Weah (Marseille) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Yvon Mvogo, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
44' The referee signals a substitution. Matt O'Riley (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Amine Gouiri.
44' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Marseille as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
39' There's a break in play and referee Thomas Leonard must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Marseille using VAR. This could be interesting!
38' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner but it's cleared.

37' Timothy Weah (Marseille) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner.
36' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle as Michael Murillo (Marseille) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
36' 4:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
33' 3 - 0 Goal! Angel Gomes (Marseille) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 3:0.
33' The referee awards a corner and Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes over to take it.
28' Thomas Leonard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Laurent Abergel (Lorient).
27' The free kick from Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
26' It's a yellow card for Benjamin Pavard (Marseille).
25' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

23' Marseille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
20' 2 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Mason Greenwood and Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top of the net. The score is 2:0.
20' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
17' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Amine Gouiri (Marseille), but Yvon Mvogo is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
14' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Noah Cadiou walks off the pitch to be replaced by Arsene Kouassi (Lorient).
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yvon Mvogo into the bottom left corner.
12' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
10' The game is interrupted as Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is sent off by the referee.

10' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. It's a penalty! Marseille have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
8' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and it's Facundo Medina (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
6' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

5' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Yvon Mvogo is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Marseille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Timothy Weah (Marseille) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
3' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lorient will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
